aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, collection times and fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time, before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Analyse sales by date range, item and event, to see what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — you do not have to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add the logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a pager number to an order when you hand it out, so you know which pager belongs to each order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers, with the order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map, so nearby customers find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show the upcoming dates on your own site. Each one leads directly to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, plus the only way to keep receiving orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much the kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a slot has filled up, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward loyal customers with digital loyalty cards with stamps — collected and used automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Group items into combos and offer additional products at checkout, to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as automatic replies on WhatsApp, for questions on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — all with the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own accounts, with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online orders are paused, so customers do not place orders you would not see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you receive orders offline too; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for items that must be ordered ahead of time.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that do not appear on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A QR code that can be printed and that opens the menu and the ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You only check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers an SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload the designs — we automatically add the dates, locations and times for each week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — it immediately appears greyed out for customers.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set the stock and it goes down as orders come in, then the item is marked sold out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a compatible phone, without a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose their collection time from a time slot, and demand is spread across the service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Receive and manage orders at the food truck, paid on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run the service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatic replies to questions on WhatsApp about the menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. When that collection time has filled up, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck — and on the card terminal you already take payment with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same schedule every week. You are somewhere else every week, at different times, with weak or no mobile signal. HatchGrab was created exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online orders are paused automatically, so customers do not place orders you would not see. Keep receiving orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in the dates, locations and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your posts on Facebook and Instagram
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order in advance and choose the collection time. Shorter queues and food ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Created for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Messages on WhatsApp get answered while you drive to the location or stand at the grill, based on your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram soon.
